text: Uploads over 8 MB time out because the retry wrapper reuses an already-consumed stream. Rewind before each retry.
The uploader lives in services/uploader.py; the retry decorator is in common/retry.py, not in the HTTP layer.
Regression tests for upload paths need a fixture larger than the 8 MB chunk size, otherwise the bug never triggers.
Login 500s last month were caused by an expired signing key, not by the auth code. Check key rotation first.
Slow dashboard queries came from a missing index on events(user_id, created_at).
The docs build fails on Windows when a README contains a bare CRLF inside a code fence.
中文 issue 里出现「超时」时，先看重试逻辑，再看网络层。
